extracted.name: Strawberry Whip
extracted.description: Very, very strawberry. Let 's see, there 's strawberry gelatin with strawberries and whipped topping stirred in. And, if you want to gild the lily, top with sliced strawberries when you serve it up in a bowl.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Combine gelatin with 2 cups boiling water; mix well. When dissolved, add 2 cups cold water, mix and refrigerate.
Before gelatin is completely firm, stir in strawberries and thawed whipped topping. Refrigerate until completely chilled.
